citation: Tsuda Y, et al. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2020;17:39
protocol: Cycle ergometer 80 min at 50% of VO2max after a standard breakfast; blood before and immediately after exercise; placebo arm of an amino-acid crossover (placebo 30 min before)
population: 15 healthy recreationally active men analysed, 32.3 +/- 1.2 y, BMI 22.3 +/- 0.4, VO2max 39.8 +/- 1.7 mL/kg/min
note: Only before/after values, but FFA, cortisol, lactate and glucose together for a long moderate bout; values are mean +/- SEM (flowchart shows 48 recruited, 15 analysed). Placebo column only.
